topic: New analytics platform overview videos launched
summary_markdown: A team member announced the launch of new video content detailing the AllUnite Analytics Platform. The videos cover four key topics: Traffic and Demographics, Inventory Management, Campaign Management System, and Campaign Planner & Optimizer. To ensure broad accessibility, the videos include subtitles in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. Participants were encouraged to share this knowledge with clients and on professional networks.
decisions: New educational video content for the Analytics Platform was launched.
action_items: Participants should share the new platform overview videos with clients and on LinkedIn.
